core_paradigm: Predictive-Processing Global-Workspace: hierarchical generative world model + global-workspace broadcast
world_model_knowledge: Transformer multimodal latent world model (generative simulator) + explicit knowledge graph
memory: Working (active latent+workspace) / episodic (retrieval store) / semantic (weights+KG) / procedural (skills)
learning: In-context (fast) + replay/regularized consolidation (slow) + RL-from-outcomes + self-supervised prediction
reasoning_planning: Prediction-as-reasoning; latent MCTS-like tree search; hierarchical (HTN) planning; active-inference exploration
perception_action_tools: Multimodal predictive-coding encoders; embodiment-agnostic action interface; tools as procedural skills
motivation_alignment: Intrinsic (prediction-error/homeostasis) + constitutional priors + corrigibility + RLHF/RLAIF + oversight
self_model_metacognition: World model includes self-model; confidence estimation; help-seeking; compute allocation
scalability_path: Scale world-model + memory + planning horizon; generality from breadth + skill acquisition + in-context adaptation

core_paradigm: Scale a transformer language model, then train reasoning with reinforcement learning on chain-of-thought (the o-series 'deliberative alignment' recipe). No named cognitive architecture; the bet is scale + RL-on-reasoning.
world_model_knowledge: Knowledge is implicit in transformer weights; no explicit world model or KG. o-series emits long internal reasoning traces as a scratchpad.
memory: Working memory = context window. No native persistent episodic/semantic store (added externally via retrieval/tools).
learning: Pretraining (self-supervised next-token) + RLHF + RL on verifiable rewards for reasoning (GRPO-style). In-context learning at inference; no continual weight updates in deployment.
reasoning_planning: Test-time compute: long RL-trained chain-of-thought 'thinking' before answering; tool use for planning. Search is implicit in the learned reasoning policy rather than explicit tree search.
perception_action_tools: Multimodal (text/image/audio in, text out); strong tool/function calling and code execution as the action interface.
motivation_alignment: RLHF + 'deliberative alignment' (model reasons about its instructions/values explicitly). Objectives set by trainers; corrigibility via training, not architectural.
self_model_metacognition: Limited explicit self-model; some calibrated confidence via sampling; reasoning traces give partial introspection.
scalability_path: Generality via scaling laws + RL on ever-harder reasoning tasks; capability grows with parameters/data/test-time compute.

core_paradigm: Generalist agent paradigm: a single multimodal model (Gato/Gemini) plus model-based RL + search (AlphaGo/AlphaFold lineage). DeepMind published a 'Levels of AGI' ontology (capability levels), which is a framework, not an architecture.
world_model_knowledge: Multimodal transformer world knowledge in weights; Alpha-family uses explicit learned simulators/search over structured state (e.g. AlphaFold structure prediction).
memory: Context window working memory; external retrieval; Alpha-family uses search over an explicit state representation as a form of episodic lookahead.
learning: Self-supervised pretraining + RL (model-based RL in Alpha-family; RLHF in Gemini). Strong emphasis on RL + planning.
reasoning_planning: Explicit model-based planning + tree search (MCTS lineage from AlphaGo) is DeepMind's signature; Gemini adds learned reasoning.
perception_action_tools: Deeply multimodal (Gato: one model across vision/language/robotics/game actions); embodiment is a core focus (robotics, SIMA agent in 3D worlds).
motivation_alignment: Reward-driven RL; alignment via RLHF + safety training; objectives from reward design.
self_model_metacognition: Not a central published component; some uncertainty estimation in RL agents.
scalability_path: Generality via generalist agents + RL + search across domains; the Levels-of-AGI framework defines the path (narrow -> competent -> expert -> virtuoso).

core_paradigm: Large (mixture-of-experts) transformer trained to 'understand the universe', with a stated emphasis on curiosity and real-time knowledge. No formal cognitive architecture published.
world_model_knowledge: Parametric knowledge in weights, augmented by real-time access to X (Twitter) data for up-to-date world knowledge.
memory: Context window working memory; real-time data retrieval as an external memory proxy.
learning: Large-scale pretraining + RLHF; MoE for efficient scaling.
reasoning_planning: Chain-of-thought reasoning modes; tool use; less emphasis on explicit search.
perception_action_tools: Multimodal (text/image); tool/function calling; real-time web/X access as tools.
motivation_alignment: RLHF alignment; stated goal of truth-seeking/curiosity; 'maximum truth-seeking' framing.
scalability_path: Generality via scaling MoE + real-time knowledge integration + reasoning.

core_paradigm: Efficient open Mixture-of-Experts transformer; R1 adds RL-trained reasoning (GRPO) without heavy supervised fine-tuning. Paradigm: efficient MoE + RL-driven emergent reasoning.
world_model_knowledge: Parametric knowledge in MoE weights; no explicit world model/KG.
memory: Context window (long-context variants); no native persistent store.
learning: Pretraining + GRPO reinforcement learning (R1) that elicits long reasoning; open weights enable community fine-tuning.
reasoning_planning: R1's RL-trained long chain-of-thought reasoning with self-verification; test-time reasoning compute.
perception_action_tools: Primarily text/code; tool use supported; multimodal limited relative to frontier labs.
motivation_alignment: RL with reward signals; alignment via RLHF; open-weight transparency.
self_model_metacognition: R1 shows emergent self-reflection/'aha' moments in reasoning traces (partial metacognition).
scalability_path: Generality via efficient MoE scaling + RL on reasoning; open ecosystem accelerates capability spread.

core_paradigm: Open MoE transformer with hybrid 'thinking/non-thinking' modes and strong agent/tool-use focus. Paradigm: efficient MoE + agentic capability.
world_model_knowledge: Parametric knowledge in MoE weights; strong multilingual coverage.
memory: Long context window; agentic memory via tool/retrieval integration.
learning: Pretraining + SFT + RL; hybrid thinking mode toggles deliberate reasoning.
reasoning_planning: Hybrid thinking mode (fast vs deliberative); strong agentic planning and tool orchestration.
perception_action_tools: Multimodal variants (Qwen-VL/Audio); strong tool/function calling and coding agents.
self_model_metacognition: Thinking mode gives partial introspection; no formal self-model.
scalability_path: Generality via MoE scaling + agentic tool use + multilingual breadth.

core_paradigm: JEPA (Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture): LeCun's named cognitive architecture. Predict in LATENT representation space (not pixel space) via a hierarchical world model; non-generative prediction avoids modeling irrelevant detail. Llama is the current LM; JEPA is the AGI proposal.
world_model_knowledge: A learned latent world model that predicts abstract representations of future states; knowledge as predictive embeddings, hierarchical across timescales.
memory: Working memory = current latent state; the architecture proposes configurable memory with a memory-encoder; episodic/semantic via the world model's latent structure.
learning: Self-supervised joint-embedding prediction (no generative reconstruction); learns by predicting latent futures — energy-based, not token-prediction.
reasoning_planning: A 'planner'/actor module optimizes actions to minimize a cost in latent space using the world model's predictions — explicit model-based planning over abstract states.
perception_action_tools: Perception = encoder into latent space; action via the actor/cost modules; designed to be embodiment-agnostic (V-JEPA 2 targets video/robotics).
motivation_alignment: A 'cost module' (intrinsic + extrinsic objectives) drives the planner; alignment framed as configurable cost functions; LeCun argues this avoids generative-model pitfalls.
self_model_metacognition: The architecture includes the agent's own state in the world model; uncertainty via energy/latent prediction confidence.
scalability_path: Generality via hierarchical latent prediction across timescales + a world model that supports planning; V-JEPA 2 is an early instantiation.

core_paradigm: Efficient open (and commercial) transformers/MoE with strong tool use; no published AGI cognitive architecture. Paradigm: efficient, deployable, agentic models.
world_model_knowledge: Parametric knowledge in weights; no explicit world model/KG.
memory: Context window working memory; agentic memory via tools/retrieval.
learning: Pretraining + instruction tuning + RLHF; efficient architectures (MoE, sliding-window attention).
reasoning_planning: Tool-augmented reasoning; agentic function calling; less emphasis on long RL reasoning than o/R1.
perception_action_tools: Multimodal (Small 3.1 is natively multimodal); strong tool/function calling and on-device deployment.
scalability_path: Generality via efficient scaling + multimodality + agentic tool use + broad deployment.
